metadata.description: A live dashboard for Claude Code: plan limits, forecast, agents, tokens and suggested next steps.

plugins.name: usage-panel-tools
plugins.description: Skills to report issues or ideas to the project and to install or update the VS Code panel. Install this one first: it works on any Claude Code version.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: The data feed for the panel and a band above the prompt (session time, tokens, context, 5h/7d limits). Needs a Claude Code version that supports mods.
